entities.summary: Juan Ronel Toscano-Anderson is a Mexican-American professional basketball player for Pallacanestro Trieste of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He played college basketball for the Marquette Golden Eagles. He won an NBA championship with the Golden State Warriors in 2022. He has also played in the NBA for the Los Angeles Lakers, Utah Jazz, and Sacramento Kings.
